title: ConvNeXt
description: Meta's ConvNeXt (tiny, small, base, large) trained on ImageNet-22k, without the classifier: the last stage's feature map as tokens and a pooled image embedding. Apache-2.0 weights.

Details
  • Paper: A ConvNet for the 2020s, CVPR 2022, 2022-01-10
  • Original code: https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models at 0df212b369a5
  • Authors' code, not used: https://github.com/facebookresearch/ConvNeXt (PyTorch): timm carries the architecture and the converted authors' checkpoints in its own, simpler API.
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files:
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/timm/convnext_base.fb_in22k/blob/9afd4146adabf1b6e861d0f1ac2e7baa7c8dd1b7/README.md
  • Training data: ImageNet-21k / ImageNet-22k (full ImageNet, fall 2011 release)
  • Kernel libraries: fvm_conv, fvm_seg
  • Variants: convnext_tiny.fb_in22k, convnext_small.fb_in22k, convnext_base.fb_in22k, convnext_large.fb_in22k
  • Outputs: last_hidden_state, pooler_output
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): convnext_tiny.fb_in22k 3000x4000 (1.9 GiB peak allocated, 2.4 reserved); convnext_small.fb_in22k 3000x4000 (1.9 GiB peak allocated, 2.5 reserved); convnext_base.fb_in22k 3000x4000 (2.5 GiB peak allocated, 3.6 reserved); convnext_large.fb_in22k 3000x4000 (3.8 GiB peak allocated, 5.2 reserved)
  • convnext_tiny.fb_in22k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 12 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 34 s (ONNX + engine).
  • convnext_small.fb_in22k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 10 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 35 s (ONNX + engine).
  • convnext_base.fb_in22k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 10 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 30 s (ONNX + engine).
  • convnext_large.fb_in22k 224x224, first call: portable + torch.compile 10 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 47 s (ONNX + engine).
  • convnext_tiny.fb_in22k original (fp32) 224x224, original 224x224: timm num_classes=0 (pooled, head norm)
  • convnext_small.fb_in22k original (fp32) 224x224, original 224x224: timm num_classes=0 (pooled, head norm)
  • convnext_base.fb_in22k original (fp32) 224x224, original 224x224: timm num_classes=0 (pooled, head norm)
  • convnext_large.fb_in22k original (fp32) 224x224, original 224x224: timm num_classes=0 (pooled, head norm)
  • convnext_tiny.fb_in22k load / first call: original 0.4 s / 0.275 s, portable 1.66 s / 0.23 s, kernels 1.57 s / 0.221 s
  • convnext_small.fb_in22k load / first call: original 0.65 s / 0.014 s, portable 1.93 s / 0.209 s, kernels 1.73 s / 0.18 s
  • convnext_base.fb_in22k load / first call: original 0.9 s / 0.019 s, portable 2.18 s / 0.237 s, kernels 2.05 s / 0.244 s
  • convnext_large.fb_in22k load / first call: original 2.17 s / 0.02 s, portable 2.71 s / 0.238 s, kernels 2.78 s / 0.232 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Two disjoint seeded subsets of the val folders; each image shorter side 256 (bicubic), centre crop 224, the CLS / pooled feature; cosine kNN, vote weighted by similarity. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Limitations

  • Only the last stage's map is returned: the maps of stages 1-3 (strides 4, 8, 16; timm features_only=True) have other sizes than the token grid of this task's outputs.
  • kernels replays a CUDA graph per small input shape (up to 2^20 input pixels per call), captured on the shape's second call, at most 4 per model; model.release_graphs() frees them.
